What it does

Connect. Pull. Build. Push.

A focused four-step workflow with your account mappings on a dedicated Excel sheet — no black boxes, no surprises in Xero.

⚡

Connect Stripe & Xero

OAuth per workspace. Tokens encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Your Xero base currency detected automatically — no manual config required.

Stripe Connect OAuth
📊

Pull balance transactions

Charges, refunds, payouts, and fees land on named Excel sheets. Filter by date range. Re-pull any time — sheets overwrite cleanly with fresh data.

Writes directly to Excel
✅

Build & push to Xero

Formula-driven journals and bank transactions from your balance data. Push as draft or posted. Row-level status writeback prevents double-posting.

Xero API

Workflow

Three steps, once a month

Typically under 15 minutes for a full month-end Stripe reconciliation.

01

Connect

Sign in, create a workspace, connect your Xero org and Stripe account. Map GL account codes once on the Account_Mappings sheet.

02

Pull & build

Pick a date range and pull balance transactions. Silkview Connect builds journal and bank transaction rows from your mapping — review and adjust freely in Excel.

03

Push

Post as draft or directly to your Xero ledger. Each row gets a Xero transaction ID written back — proof it's posted, protection against duplicates.

Why Silkview Connect

You review before Xero sees anything

Other tools push straight to Xero automatically. You find errors at BAS time. Silkview Connect gives you the Excel review step accountants actually want.

  • Full Excel control before any push

    Formulas, adjustments, custom account codes — your workbook, your rules. We read whatever you've built and push it as-is.

  • Clearing account pattern, done correctly

    Revenue recognised on charge date. Payout moves clearing to bank. GST split automatically via Xero's tax engine.

  • Multi-client ready for accounting firms

    Firm plan: 5 workspaces, each with its own Stripe and Xero connection. One tool for your entire Stripe client book.
